title_ja: 保護対象の文字列と値を維持する
requirement_en: Keep protected source fields unchanged, including names, prices, quantities, units and punctuation. Compare exact source sequences; visual similarity does not establish preservation.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Compare the approved input and extracted output only where a supported exact-text extractor exists; otherwise require manual evidence. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not rewrite protected fields. A newly authorized source revision establishes a new comparison baseline, not a silent correction.

exception_policy.bounds: No waiver for silently changed protected content; explicitly editable fields are outside the protected scope.

title_ja: 実在する根拠のない主張を載せない
requirement_en: Trace performance numbers, endorsements, customer identities and logos to supplied evidence and usage permission. Missing proof is not permission to invent a plausible claim.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Review each factual assertion and asset against supplied evidence; this is not an automated semantic-truth detector. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Remove or flag unsubstantiated claims only under explicit refine authorization; never fabricate replacement testimonials or metrics.

exception_policy.bounds: Clearly labeled fictional material can be outside real-world claim scope; it must not imply actual customers or achievements.

title_ja: 不可視文字と空白の必要性を確かめる
requirement_en: Identify newly added invisible characters or spacing by source comparison and explain their function. Preserve intentional separators, combining marks and variation selectors instead of deleting every nonprinting code point.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: An exact code-point diff can locate changes; deciding whether they are legitimate requires context and may require manual review. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: No blanket whitespace stripping or deletion of joiners, variation selectors or combining characters.

exception_policy.bounds: Intentional source characters are not violations merely because they are invisible; unsupported extraction remains not-checked.

title_ja: 原稿へ一括の文字正規化をかけない
requirement_en: Do not apply blanket Unicode normalization to source content. Preserve compatibility forms, original punctuation, variation sequences and decomposed characters unless a specific editable field has separate explicit authorization.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Compare original code points, not only normalized strings; no normalization-based equality shortcut proves preservation. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Never use broad NFKC or NFC rewriting as an unrequested typography repair. Keep authorized derived search data separate from source.

exception_policy.bounds: A separately authorized derived field may have its own transformation; protected source remains exact.

title_ja: 素材の由来と利用条件を残す
requirement_en: Record origin, source identifier, license or permission basis and intended use for images, fonts and other assets. Unavailable rights evidence must remain an explicit limitation.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Inspect actual rights records and asset provenance; a URL or attractive preview alone is not permission. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not infer a license, copy a font file or redistribute source figures to fill missing metadata.

exception_policy.bounds: Original or public-domain material still needs an attributable provenance record; unverifiable rights cannot be labeled verified.

title_ja: 言語と組方向と書体の前提を記す
requirement_en: Declare the content language, intended writing direction and font/fallback policy for the selected medium. Check those declarations against actual text and available rendering.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Inspect host language/writing-mode settings and rendered glyphs; language metadata alone does not prove layout quality. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Change settings only in authorized regions; do not alter names or substitute unlicensed fonts.

exception_policy.bounds: Bound exceptions to a named mixed-language or display region; verify current approval and unchanged protected content.

title_ja: 実際の行端で禁則を確認する
requirement_en: Review actual rendered line starts and ends against the chosen Japanese composition profile. Punctuation occurring somewhere in source text is not itself a line-edge violation.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Use observed line boxes and relevant character classes in the actual font, direction and width; no universal kinsoku detector is provided. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Propose layout changes instead of silently changing punctuation or source text.

exception_policy.bounds: A deliberate display exception needs exact scope, rationale and verified approver/expiry/subject binding; it remains waived.

title_ja: 分割しない範囲を文脈で選ぶ
requirement_en: Identify sequences that need to remain together under the selected composition and content context. Verify their rendered treatment without turning an entire paragraph or long control label into an unbreakable block.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Review character sequence classes and actual line placement, including overflow introduced by attempted grouping. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Avoid blanket nowrap; preserve the source and adjust only a justified local grouping.

exception_policy.bounds: A context-specific break or grouping must be bounded and approved; required content and controls must stay available.

title_ja: 意味のまとまりと禁則を別に評価する
requirement_en: Judge whether short headings and controls remain understandable when wrapped, separately from Japanese punctuation line-edge constraints. A mid-word wrap is not automatically a kinsoku failure.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Use semantic review of the actual label and line placement; language-model judgment is assisted, not deterministic verification. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not replace every natural wrap with nowrap or insert unrequested source spaces.

exception_policy.bounds: Readable constrained wraps can pass on their merits; genuine project exceptions require bounded current approval.

title_ja: 本文と見出しの字詰めを分けて扱う
requirement_en: Choose spacing treatment by text role. Body reading and short display lettering require separate rationale and rendered review; a display tightening choice must not automatically cascade through body text.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Compare role-scoped styles and actual reading samples; no universal tracking value is prescribed. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Confine optical or tight spacing proposals to the justified role and preserve source characters.

exception_policy.bounds: Approved display treatment can differ from body metrics; approval and readability evidence remain scoped to that region.

title_ja: フォント機能の有無と適用範囲を調べる
requirement_en: Before using palt or another OpenType feature, identify the actual font, feature support and intended text role. A CSS feature declaration does not prove that the font implements it or that all text benefits.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Inspect font support and compare affected glyph positioning in the available renderer; palt is discretionary and font-dependent. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Never force palt on all body text, replace a font without permission or pretend unsupported features were tested.

exception_policy.bounds: Normal metrics or unavailable features may be appropriate; record inapplicability or unsupported checks instead of forcing an alternative.

title_ja: 約物の空き方を組版方針と照合する
requirement_en: Use a coherent punctuation-spacing and line-edge adjustment approach for each declared composition profile. Review consecutive punctuation and line ends rather than mixing unrelated application presets.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Inspect representative punctuation combinations and real line ends; application behavior may differ. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not insert or delete source punctuation to imitate another engine; propose scoped layout changes.

exception_policy.bounds: Different named roles may use different deliberate conventions if their bounds, rationale and approval are recorded.

title_ja: 和欧混植の見え方を原稿を変えず調整する
requirement_en: Review relative glyph scale, baseline and spacing where Japanese text meets Latin letters or numerals. Use layout treatment appropriate to the role rather than automatically inserting spaces into source strings.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Review mixed-script samples in actual fonts and preserve protected identifiers, prices and punctuation. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: No blanket spacing insertion or universal numeral enlargement; source tokens must remain intact.

exception_policy.bounds: A compact protected identifier may intentionally differ from surrounding prose; bounded approval does not authorize changing the identifier.

title_ja: 行長と行送りと字間を一緒に検討する
requirement_en: Choose measure, leading and tracking together for the actual font, text role and medium. A single character-count or line-height recipe is not a universal reading requirement.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Review sustained-reading samples and role tokens at actual output sizes; numeric examples from another system are contextual only. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Change only authorized layout tokens; do not force identical body, caption, UI and presentation measures.

exception_policy.bounds: Short captions and display roles can use distinct tested treatment; a genuine waiver needs scoped current approval.

title_ja: ルビと注記の衝突と読む順序を調べる
requirement_en: Review ruby, annotations and neighboring text throughout the relevant pages or view states. They must remain legible, correctly associated and in a usable reading order.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Inspect full relevant pages/views and annotation associations; absence of a suitable renderer remains not-checked or unsupported. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not remove notes, shrink them to illegibility or rewrite protected source to conceal collisions.

exception_policy.bounds: An intentional bounded annotation arrangement requires approval and evidence that necessary information remains available.

title_ja: 表示幅と実効文字サイズから改行の必要性と行全体のバランスを判断する
requirement_en: Preserve supplied text, kinsoku, reading order and accessible reflow. Measure actual inline content width, effective type, used fonts, zoom and spacing before deciding whether intentional breaks are necessary. Use ordinary wrapping as the comparison baseline. Prefer meaningful multi-bunsetsu groups only when they fit and improve the entire composition; do not require breaks at every bunsetsu or fixed two-line headings. At narrow width/large type, prioritize removing unnecessary author-controlled phrase breaks and compare normal, balance, auto-phrase and their combination by rendered line count, widths, ragging, intermediate and final short lines, reading flow and surrounding whitespace. No universal ratio threshold or perfect segmentation is guaranteed.

conditions.when: Named short Japanese copy; measured width/type relationship and approved intent determine whether phrase control is useful. Naturally fitting copy needs no added break absent approved intent. Long body text retains ordinary wrapping. Record native zoom separately from CSS simulation.
conditions.scope: named short Japanese copy region

verification.notes: Assisted guidance only; record actual DOM text, measured line maps/widths, used fonts, clipping/overflow and qualitative composition review separately. CSS support is not proof of quality, accessibility or host coverage. Unrendered states are not-checked; unresolved composition is needs-review.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Compare normal reflow first. Use layout changes or optional phrase aids only when they improve the whole heading under actual conditions. Remove unnecessary author-controlled breaks where groups cannot fit; do not force every phrase, fixed lines, nowrap/max-content, clipping, visible or zero-width characters, uniform shrinking or a universal font preset. Preserve approved copy and local emphasis; request reconsideration if access conflicts remain.

exception_policy.bounds: A valid approved local emphasis may differ. No exception allows truncation, source mutation or inaccessible layout.

title_ja: 狭い表示でも内容と操作を保つ
requirement_en: For applicable one-dimensional web content, inspect vertically scrolling content at a width equivalent to 320 CSS pixels and horizontally scrolling content at a height equivalent to 256 CSS pixels. Determine the threshold from the actual scrolling axis, not the text's reading direction. Required information and functions must remain available without unintended two-axis scrolling.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Use real viewport-equivalent rendering and operation; record width, direction and actual content availability. Viewport resizing does not prove text zoom or other browser coverage. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Fix the responsible width/layout; never hide required content merely to make the screenshot fit.

exception_policy.bounds: Criterion-specific necessary two-dimensional regions may be inapplicable locally. A project waiver with lost content remains waived and cannot establish WCAG conformance.

title_ja: 文字の拡大を実際の操作と確認する
requirement_en: For applicable text, test an actual supported text-enlargement mechanism through 200 percent, retaining content and function. A smaller authored font must not defeat the required enlargement.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Record the real enlargement mechanism and intermediate/maximum states; viewport width changes alone are not this test. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not counteract enlargement with scaling or forced tiny text; keep authorized content and controls usable.

exception_policy.bounds: Assess the criterion-specific exclusions and user-agent-controlled content explicitly. A project waiver is not a standards-conformance pass.

title_ja: 利用者の文字間隔変更に耐えるか試す
requirement_en: Where the language/script uses the relevant spacing properties, apply the criterion user-style changes and check that content and function survive. Test line height 1.5 times font size, paragraph spacing 2 times font size, letter spacing 0.12 times font size and word spacing 0.16 times font size as applicable.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Apply actual user-style overrides to the target and inspect resulting states; these values are resilience tests, not required initial CSS defaults. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not force unused spacing properties into Japanese source or remove text to accommodate the override.

exception_policy.bounds: Only the properties meaningful for the language/script apply; document that scope rather than imposing a universal baseline.

title_ja: 全体の切り取りで情報損失を隠さない
requirement_en: Investigate substantive overflow instead of hiding it behind page-wide clipping. Required text, controls and focus indication must remain accessible in the tested state.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Inspect both relevant CSS and actual overflow/access; a clipping declaration alone does not prove content loss. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Correct the causal width or placement within authorization; never use global clipping as proof of successful reflow.

exception_policy.bounds: Bounded decorative cropping with no informational or interactive loss is outside this prohibition; required content cannot be waived away.

title_ja: 長い表示文字列を実条件で試す
requirement_en: Exercise long labels, URLs and protected names or identifiers at narrow widths and actual enlargement. Full content access and required operation matter more than enforcing a one-line appearance.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Inspect real rendering, focus/activation and complete text access; a usable two-line button is not automatically a failure. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: No universal nowrap or overflow-wrap:anywhere prescription; preserve protected tokens and choose a local treatment.

exception_policy.bounds: A justified local reveal or wrap may be acceptable with complete access; actual project exceptions require scoped approval.

title_ja: 画像内の文字の必要性を区別する
requirement_en: Use real text for information when the available technology can provide its required presentation. Identify criterion-specific customizable or essential presentations rather than converting ordinary text to an image for convenience.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Inspect structure, image purpose and alternatives; logotypes and genuine essential presentations have distinct applicability. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not rasterize body copy to hide layout problems or infer asset rights from the criterion exception.

exception_policy.bounds: Record the applicable essential/customizable exception and its accessible context; an ordinary waiver cannot claim WCAG conformance.

title_ja: 読み込まれた書体と代替表示を確認する
requirement_en: Verify actual font loading, glyph coverage and fallback rendering in the target environment. Record which fonts were observed and which fallback conditions remain untested.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Observe loaded/fallback faces and representative source glyphs; a declared family list is not verification of coverage. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not bundle or download font files without authorization and rights; preserve source characters when glyphs are unavailable.

exception_policy.bounds: Fallback can be deliberate if its actual readability and coverage are checked; missing checks remain explicit limitations.

title_ja: 必要な操作状態を表示して検査する
requirement_en: Review the states the actual interface requires, including focus, errors and relevant loading or disabled states. A single default screenshot cannot establish that the interaction works.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Exercise applicable controls and inspect each required state; static content with no such control must not acquire fictitious UI states. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Modify only authorized real controls; do not invent testimonials, dashboards or interaction results.

exception_policy.bounds: State applicability follows the actual UI; any genuine exception must preserve necessary information and operation with bounded approval.

title_ja: 見出しと改ページのつながりを確認する
requirement_en: Review all relevant rendered pages for stranded headings and disruptive page breaks. Judge the reading relationship between headings and their content rather than relying solely on document structure.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Inspect the actual page sequence and any intentional section openings in the available output environment. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Propose pagination or section grouping without deleting or rewriting protected source.

exception_policy.bounds: An intentional section opening or display page can differ from body pagination when justified and approved.

title_ja: 図表と付随情報を元資料に照合する
requirement_en: Check figures, tables, annotations, footnotes and page numbers against original data and their rendered associations. Preserve values and explanatory notes across the entire relevant document.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Combine exact source-data comparison where supported with whole-page review; neither alone proves all annotation relationships. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not delete notes, alter values or invent source data to resolve crowded pages.

exception_policy.bounds: A deliberate bounded relocation must preserve content and associations and receive current approval.

title_ja: 縮小だけに頼らずスライドを組み直す
requirement_en: Evaluate presentation density and readable type under the intended viewing or projection conditions. Prefer splitting or restructuring authorized information over shrinking all text until it technically fits.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Review actual output at the declared viewing conditions; no universal point size is claimed. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Keep protected wording and data intact; propose slide division or hierarchy changes only within refine authorization.

exception_policy.bounds: A bounded secondary detail treatment needs explicit rationale, readable access and current approval; unseen projection conditions remain untested.

title_ja: 変換後の文字と編集性を別々に確かめる
requirement_en: After export or conversion, compare text, fonts and required editability with the original, then review the result in the actual target application when available. Another renderer does not establish native compatibility.

conditions.when: Apply only to the stated text role, medium and actual target; determine applicability before assigning a result.
conditions.scope: selected profile and named target region

verification.notes: Record the conversion path, target application and checks actually performed; mark unavailable native rendering or editability checks separately. This catalog ships guidance, not a detector.

protected_content: original names, prices, values, units, punctuation, variation selectors and decomposed Unicode
fix_policy.guidance: Do not silently normalize text, replace fonts or promise all-application compatibility.

exception_policy.bounds: An authorized output format may intentionally remove editability; record that bounded requirement rather than claiming it was retained.

title_ja: 制作前に目的と構成判断を固定する
requirement_en: Record the actual purpose, audience, information priorities, intended action and a purpose-specific structure rationale before production. Verify current attributable authorization for that exact contract and scope; later explanations do not replace missing chronology.

conditions.when: Evaluate only against the actual brief, selected medium, protected brand/content and available evidence.
conditions.scope: named design or component

verification.notes: Inspect preserved brief/contract bytes, production boundary and independently verified authorization; a true boolean or opaque approval reference cannot establish chronology or authority. This rule ships guidance, not an automated design detector.

protected_content: approved source strings, prices, names, punctuation and protected brand identity
fix_policy.guidance: Do not fabricate an earlier decision, backdate a contract or change protected content. A new authorized refine pass gets its own prior contract and retains the earlier failure.

exception_policy.bounds: No waiver for retroactive justification or missing production permission. Legitimate brand constraints must be recorded before use, and a fresh refine contract only governs its new production boundary.

title_ja: 構成の再利用を実際の目的で説明する
requirement_en: Choose structure from the brief instead of repeating the same Hero/cards/CTA arrangement across materially different objectives without justification. Review repeated structures against actual information relationships; changing accent colors alone is not a structural rationale.

conditions.when: Evaluate only against the actual brief, selected medium, protected brand/content and available evidence.
conditions.scope: named design or component

conditions.when: An explicit strict review policy was selected before production and materially different briefs receive repeated structure without a purpose-specific rationale.
conditions.scope: compared structures under that declared policy

verification.notes: Compare briefs, chosen structures and their reasons using assisted or manual review. Three peer choices may legitimately use three cards; no motif counter is a design-quality detector. This rule ships guidance, not an automated design detector.

protected_content: approved source strings, prices, names, punctuation and protected brand identity
fix_policy.guidance: Propose a purpose-specific information structure within refine authorization. Do not remove useful brand components solely for novelty or infer a failure from the number of cards.

exception_policy.bounds: An approved brand component that fits the actual information can pass on its merits. Any genuine project waiver requires current authorized scope/reason/expiry/subject binding and stays waived.

title_ja: 表示する装飾と主張と操作に実体を持たせる
requirement_en: Use visual elements because they explain information, support hierarchy or provide a real action. Do not populate empty layout regions with invented metrics, testimonials, customer assets or simulated controls presented as actual functionality.

conditions.when: Evaluate only against the actual brief, selected medium, protected brand/content and available evidence.
conditions.scope: named design or component

conditions.when: Decoration or simulated UI misrepresents real claims/functions or obstructs necessary information; content and permission blockers retain their independent severity.
conditions.scope: misrepresented claim/control or obscured information

verification.notes: Trace real-world claims and assets to evidence/rights; examine whether each control actually works and whether decoration obscures reading. An assisted design review is not a semantic-truth detector. This rule ships guidance, not an automated design detector.

protected_content: approved source strings, prices, names, punctuation and protected brand identity
fix_policy.guidance: Do not invent replacements or unauthorized assets. Distinguish a clearly labeled explanatory diagram from a real interface and preserve source information during approved changes.

exception_policy.bounds: Clearly labeled original fiction or noninteractive explanation may be outside real-world claim/control scope. There is no waiver for deception, unsupported claims or concealed necessary information.

title_ja: ブランドの連続性と企画の構成を分ける
requirement_en: Keep protected brand identity and useful approved conventions consistent while tailoring structure to each actual purpose. Difference between projects does not require arbitrary changes to every familiar component.

conditions.when: Evaluate only against the actual brief, selected medium, protected brand/content and available evidence.
conditions.scope: named design or component

verification.notes: Compare the current brief with attributable brand constraints, authorized components and observed readability. Brand approval alone does not prove that a component suits this brief. This rule ships guidance, not an automated design detector.

protected_content: approved source strings, prices, names, punctuation and protected brand identity
fix_policy.guidance: Do not change protected identity or navigation to appear novel. Request scoped refine authorization for a justified campaign-specific adaptation.

exception_policy.bounds: A bounded authorized adaptation may differ from the normal brand pattern; verify current approval and preserve unaffected brand obligations and readable access.

title_ja: 色と書体と余白を役割で定義する
requirement_en: Assign color, typography and spacing choices to explicit information and interaction roles. Match the definitions to actual available fonts/assets and rendered output, including permitted fallback treatment.

conditions.when: Evaluate only against the actual brief, selected medium, protected brand/content and available evidence.
conditions.scope: named design or component

verification.notes: Inspect role tokens and their actual rendering, contrast/readability, glyph coverage and fallback. Token names or an adopted system example do not prove availability or universal suitability. This rule ships guidance, not an automated design detector.

protected_content: approved source strings, prices, names, punctuation and protected brand identity
fix_policy.guidance: Do not import fonts without authorization and rights or silently rewrite source to fit a token. Propose only scoped changes and record unavailable rendering as untested.

exception_policy.bounds: An authorized local brand or fallback treatment can differ from default tokens if its roles and actual readability are evidenced; a genuine waiver needs bounded current approval.

title_ja: 形式だけでデザインを排除しない
requirement_en: Evaluate a card layout, gradient, symmetry or other visual treatment against the actual purpose, brand constraints and readability. Neither the presence nor absence of a named motif establishes quality or a design-origin verdict.

conditions.when: Evaluate only against the actual brief, selected medium, protected brand/content and available evidence.
conditions.scope: named design or component

verification.notes: Review purpose-specific reasons and observed readable access; a motif count cannot replace contextual judgment. Judge the actual design rather than infer its origin. This rule ships guidance, not an automated design detector.

protected_content: approved source strings, prices, names, punctuation and protected brand identity
fix_policy.guidance: Do not ban whole families of treatment or blindly approve a brand motif. Propose changes only where evidence identifies a real mismatch or reading problem.

exception_policy.bounds: A deliberate approved treatment can pass when its actual use is appropriate; exceptions cannot hide required information or substitute for readability evidence.
